model: Model DM-700 electrochemical toxic gas / oxygen sensor (RS-485 Modbus)
applies_to: Teledyne Detcon DM-700 smart sensors with the 4-20 mA and RS-485 Modbus outputs, instruction manual Document #3207, Rev. 5.9.
summary: The DM-700 is a Teledyne Detcon fixed electrochemical toxic gas / oxygen sensor that reports over a 4-20 mA loop and a Modbus RTU RS-485 port at the same time. It exposes 22 holding registers: range, gas reading, span level, sensor life, fault bits, loop current, supply voltage, model-specific diagnostics, a calibration command register and the gas/units text. This map covers all of them except temperature.

addressing.note: The manual prints registers as 40000-40021, starting at 40000, so the digits after the leading 4 are the 0-based wire address: 40000 (device type) is address 0 and 40002 (gas reading) is address 2. Only function 03 reads them; writable ones use function 06.

notes: All registers are single 16-bit holding registers; the manual shares one table across DM, FP, IR, TP and PI sensors and model register 40006 tells them apart. Registers 40011-40014 change meaning with the model; only the DM-700 meanings are given here.
Gas reading scaling (manual footnote 3): the register holds the reading x1, x10 or x100 when Low Range (40011) is 0, 1 or 2. Because the multiplier changes with the range, scale is left at 1.
Range, reading and span level are in the units of the notation string (PPM, PPB or %).
Register 40010 (temperature, °C) is left out: the manual gives no data type, so it is unclear how readings below 0 °C are coded.
The notation string stores the first character in the low byte of each register (low byte, high byte, ...), the reverse of the usual Modbus string order.
Bit 13 of the fault register is reserved.
Factory serial ID is 01; it is set in the sensor menu (Set Serial ID) in hexadecimal.

registers.name: Detectable range
registers.description: Full scale in the units of the notation string.

registers.name: Gas concentration
registers.description: Raw reading; divide by 1, 10 or 100 per Low Range (register 40011).

registers.name: AutoSpan level
registers.description: Span gas concentration used for calibration.

registers.name: Fault status bits
registers.description: Faults clear themselves when the condition clears.

registers.name: Low Range
registers.description: Decimal places of the gas reading.

registers.name: Cell polarity / bias
registers.description: High nibble 8 = positive polarity cell, 0 = negative; low bits: 0x000 = 0 mV, 0x096 = 150 mV, 0x0C8 = 200 mV, 0x12C = 300 mV bias.

registers.name: Calibration status / enable
registers.description: Read gives status; write starts an action.

values.1: Read: zero calibration started / Write: set zero
values.2: Read: span calibration started / Write: set span

registers.name: Gas/units notation string
registers.description: Units, a space, then gas name, null-terminated; first character in the low byte of each register.

integration.summary: Give each sensor its own serial ID from the magnetic-switch menu, wire RS-485 at 9600 8N1 and poll holding registers 0-9 with function 03; read 40005 for faults.
integration.enable: The manual describes no separate enable step; set a unique serial ID in Program Mode (Set Serial ID).
quirks: Register numbers start at 40000 = wire address 0.
The text names function 03 as the only supported code, but the register table lists function 06 for writing the R/W registers.
Text characters are low byte first.
setup: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
Serial ID is entered in hexadecimal (01, 02 ... 0A ...).
gotchas: Bit 14 of the fault register is set while the sensor is in calibration.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
